    step=16;side=2*step

            oy=rng.integers(grain.shape[0]);ox=rng.integers(grain.shape[1])
            patch=grain[np.ix_((oy+np.arange(side))%grain.shape[0],(ox+np.arange(side))%grain.shape[1])]
